items.title: Pay 'processing fee' to claim refund
items.quote: Damit wir sie auszahlen können, überweisen Sie bitte die einmalige Bearbeitungsgebühr von 49,90 € bis zum 27.11.2026 auf das Konto IBAN CY17 0020 0128 0000 0012 0052 7600.
items.computation: The letter states an explicit calendar date, 27.11.2026, as the deadline for the fee payment. No statutory period rules apply since an exact date is given. Note: this is used only to record what the letter demands, not as a recommendation to pay — see warnings.

warnings: This letter shows strong signs of an advance-fee ('upfront fee') scam: an unsolicited, unexpectedly large 'refund' is promised only after paying a smaller 'processing fee' in advance to a foreign account.
The payee IBAN (CY17...) is in Cyprus, which is highly unusual and suspicious for a German energy-cost refund scheme; legitimate German refunds never require you to pay a fee first.
The sender's address is in Nicosia, Cyprus, not Germany, despite addressing a German consumer about German energy costs — a mismatch typical of scam letters.

There is no legal basis, authority, or contract referenced that would entitle a 'Verbraucher-Rückerstattungsstelle Energie' to collect money on behalf of energy providers or the state; this does not appear to be an official or regulated body.
The artificial urgency ('Verstreicht die Frist, verfällt Ihr Anspruch endgültig.') and promise of fast payout ('innerhalb von 48 Stunden') are classic pressure tactics used in scams.

Recommendation: do not transfer any money to this account; verify independently (e.g. via your actual energy supplier or consumer protection agency such as Verbraucherzentrale NRW) and consider reporting this letter as a potential scam.
